title: Annotating Antisemitic Online Content. Towards an Applicable Definition of Antisemitism
benchmark_measurement: Detection of antisemitism (hatred towards Jews) and related stereotypes in online tweets, based on the IHRA Working Definition of Antisemitism. It also involved classifying sentiment towards Jews, Judaism, or Israel.
findings: Tentative results from annotating random samples of tweets from 2018 suggest that more than ten percent of conversations on Twitter about Jews and Israel are antisemitic or probably antisemitic (12-18% for keyword 'Jew*' and 11-14% for 'Israel'). In conversations about Jews, an equally high number of tweets denounce antisemitism (15-19%). The study argues that the IHRA definition of antisemitism can be successfully applied to online messages if context is considered, but annotators must be highly trained and knowledgeable to do so accurately.
